notes.title: Morningstar: Descent to Deadrock Updates!
notes.content:
We've updated Morningstar: Descent to Deadrock! The latest update to version 1.2 includes: 

[list][*]Brand new soundtrack song "Rockingstar"!
[*]Minor game logic tweaks
[*]Bugfixes
[*]Added windowed mode. Steam will offer the option to launch the game in windowed mode[/list]

Enjoy the updated version of the game and the new music!
